comment: Curated allowlist of well-known Ethereum mainnet spender contracts. Keys are lowercase addresses; values are human labels. Sources: canonical deployment addresses published by each protocol — Uniswap Labs deployment docs (V2 Router 02, V3 SwapRouter02, Permit2), 1inch docs (AggregationRouterV5/V6), 0x docs (Exchange Proxy), OpenSea/ProjectOpenSea Seaport repo (Seaport 1.5/1.6), Aave address book (V3 Ethereum Pool), CoW Protocol docs (GPv2Settlement). Re-verify against Etherscan before mainnet demo.
